title: kbgit.py upstream brings the public copy's main into the clone's main by a written policy and lists the local commits that change upstream-owned paths
goal: kbgit.py upstream fetches the upstream remote alone and brings its main into the clone's integration main by the policy git.md writes down, never rewriting a commit the integration remote holds; it lists each local commit that changes a path the upstream main also tracks, marking one whose change the upstream main now holds as resolved upstream with the revert to drop it; --dry-run prints the plan and changes nothing; the gate and the push stay kbgit.py sync --push

run: import subprocess,sys;p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbgit.py','upstream','--help'],capture_output=True,text=True);sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==0 and '--dry-run' in p.stdout else 1)
